cadence_scope: RT saved-node comparisons are directly comparable to recorded RT cadence; all-native-node SCRIPT comparisons diagnose interpolation sensitivity. Sparse late-stage interpolation can suppress errors.

script_provenance.modifications: None. The files listed above are unmodified upstream bytes.
script_provenance.scope: Original photon allocation and periodic shell ordering only. Native 21cmFAST supplies the source and atom grids; the rest of the SCRIPT simulation is not used.

interpretation: Empirical spatial sensitivity for this realization and scales, not absolute truth error or a universal SCRIPT tolerance. Coeval SCRIPT and causal RT have different transport assumptions. No per-bin RT<=SCRIPT acceptance test is imposed.
matched_xHI_scope: First saved descending bracket; convex interpolation of xHI and native brightness fields before spectra; no extrapolation. Different epochs and evolving density remain.
power_denominator: Finer-refinement native brightness after conservative restriction to the native output grid
protocol: Original coeval SCRIPT; fixed physical source/gas clouds. Fine-cell count units multiply both photons and atoms by f**3; physical counts are unchanged. Restrict ions and atoms separately before xHI and native brightness. No emissivity calibration or global physical rescaling.

working_assessment.basis: Same seed222 native source/gas history, common 8^3 output grid, 21 identical saved nodes, and f1 to f2 at fixed other RT settings. RT field MAE is lower and three of four shell power changes are lower than SCRIPT; the RT first-shell change is larger.
limits: One seed and a small 50 cMpc box, with native 8^3 output.
The RT f2 to f4 spatial pair and equivalent full 81-node RT output are absent.
Sparse late-stage matched interpolation can suppress errors; inspect the 81-node SCRIPT diagnostics.
Coarse SCRIPT f1 to f2 sensitivity is not its own converged error estimate; the f2 to f4 pair is reported separately.
working_assessment.not_an_acceptance_test: No per-bin rule requiring RT change <= SCRIPT change, no universal 5% or 1% criterion, and SCRIPT is not a truth field.
working_assessment.status: Mixed comparable-order spatial sensitivity at the demonstrated stage; broader certification unavailable.
